settings.heading: Questions & Answers
settings.accent: The short version of everything people ask at the counter
settings.text: Have another question? Call (941) 369-1628 or use our contact form.

settings.heading: How can I check if an item is available?
settings.row_content: Contact the boutique with the style, color, and size you have in mind. Availability changes as items sell.

settings.heading: Can I arrange in-store pickup?
settings.row_content: Call the boutique to confirm item availability and pickup arrangements before visiting.

settings.heading: How can I ask about shipping?
settings.row_content: Contact us with the item and delivery destination so we can confirm the available options.

settings.heading: Can I put something on hold?
settings.row_content: Call or message the boutique to ask whether the item can be held for you.

settings.heading: What is the return or exchange policy?
settings.row_content: Please confirm return and exchange terms with the boutique before purchasing. Contact us with your receipt or order details for help with an existing purchase.

settings.heading: How do I get help with an order?
settings.row_content: Call (941) 369-1628 or email beyoutifulboutiquebymichele@gmail.com with your order details.

settings.heading: What if an item arrives damaged or incorrect?
settings.row_content: Contact the boutique with your order number, a description of the issue, and photos so we can help.

settings.heading: What sizes do you carry?
settings.row_content: The boutique carries styles in sizes XXS to 3X. Available sizes vary by item and brand.

settings.heading: How do I choose a size?
settings.row_content: Fit varies by brand and style. See our sizing help and contact us about the particular item before ordering.

settings.heading: Do you restock sold-out items?
settings.row_content: Contact us about a specific style to ask whether more are expected.

settings.heading: Can you help me choose a gift?
settings.row_content: Visit the boutique or contact us for help exploring accessories and gifts.
